name: Zur
overview: Zur was a male Midianite who served as the head of a household in Midian. He is noted primarily for his familial role within the Midianite tribe. Scripture identifies him as the father of Cozbi, marking his significance within the genealogical and tribal context of the Old Testament.
namesAndTitles: The name Zur means 'rock,' a proper name that is not indicated to have been given by God. This meaning reflects a common Hebrew practice of using strong, foundational imagery for personal names.
familyAndRelationships: Zur is explicitly identified as a descendant of Midian and is the father of Cozbi. Scripture does not record other family relationships beyond these, focusing on his role within the Midianite lineage.
scriptureSignificance: Zur's importance in the biblical narrative centers on his leadership within the Midianite tribe and his paternal connection to Cozbi. His mention situates him within the broader story of Israel's interactions with Midian, emphasizing the tribal and familial dynamics at play. Though details are limited, his role as a household head underscores the social structure of Midian during this period.
